versions.subject: Merge PR #4398 from @nasbench & @frack113  - Update File Access Rules
versions.detection:
selection:
    FileName|endswith:
        - '.hive'
        - '.reg'
filter_main_generic:
    Image|contains:
        - ':\Program Files (x86)\'
        - ':\Program Files\'
        - ':\Windows\System32\'
        - ':\Windows\SysWOW64\'
condition: selection and not 1 of filter_main_*
versions.spl: FileName IN ("*.hive", "*.reg") NOT (Image IN ("*:\\Program Files (x86)\\*", "*:\\Program Files\\*", "*:\\Windows\\System32\\*", "*:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\*"))
